bib.title: StyleGAN-T: Unlocking the Power of GANs for Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Image Synthesis

question: What changes to a StyleGAN-XL-style GAN make it competitive with diffusion and autoregressive models for large-scale text-to-image synthesis while keeping single-forward-pass speed?
hypothesis: A redesigned generator and discriminator plus CLIP guidance and truncation can let GANs regain competitiveness in text-to-image synthesis.
contributions: Redesigned generator (residual convs, stronger text conditioning with 2nd-order style)
CLIP guidance loss during training, text-encoder fine-tuning phase and explicit truncation for variation vs text alignment tradeoff
~1B parameter GAN trained on 250M pairs that beats distilled diffusion models in quality and speed

method.summary: StyleGAN-T starts from StyleGAN-XL, swaps class conditioning for CLIP ViT-L/14 text embeddings, drops StyleGAN3 equivariance for a StyleGAN2 backbone with residual blocks and a 2nd-order style mechanism, uses a frozen DINO ViT-S discriminator feature network with 5 heads, and adds a CLIP-based guidance loss, a text-encoder training phase and truncation. Ablations use a lightweight config on CC12M at 64x64; the final model (~1B params) trains on 250M pairs with progressive growing up to 512x512.
method.task: text-to-image synthesis (GAN), zero-shot MS COCO evaluation

datasets.name: Union: CC12m, CC, YFCC100m (filtered), Redcaps, LAION-aesthetic-6+ (full config)
datasets.source: Changpinyo 2021; Sharma 2018; Thomee 2016 / Singh 2022; Desai 2021; Schuhmann 2022

datasets.name: MS COCO (zero-shot)
datasets.size: 30k samples for FID30k; 5k for FID5k in Fig 5/6
datasets.preprocessing: downsampled with Lanczos to 64x64 / 256x256 where marked

models.name: StyleGAN-T
models.architecture: StyleGAN2-style generator with residual conv blocks, GroupNorm, Layer Scale, Fourier-feature input; DINO ViT-S/16 discriminator with 5 heads

other.text_encoder: CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder, 123 million params

models.name: StyleGAN-XL
models.architecture: StyleGAN3 layers, DeiT-M and EfficientNet frozen feature nets, 8 discriminator heads

training.objective: Non-saturating-style GAN with per-token hinge loss on every discriminator head, plus L_CLIP = arccos^2(c_image . c_text) guidance; inferred: generator and discriminator adversarial training
training.steps: Full: 16x16 118,000 it; 32x32 78,000 it; 64x64 57,000 it; secondary phase 20,000 it; 128x128 10,000; 256x256 6,000; 512x512 3,000. Lightweight: 25 million iterations (as printed)
training.regularisation: Differentiable augmentation (Zhao 2020) before the feature net, random crops above 224x224; virtual-batch BatchNorm without running stats in discriminator heads; EMA 0.9978
training.compute: Full: 450+450+450+190+96+70+30 A100 days per Table 5; budget about a quarter of Stable Diffusion's
training.wall_clock: 4 weeks: primary phase 3 weeks (up to 64x64), secondary phase 2 days, primary phase again 5 days (up to 512x512)

other.clip_guidance_weight: 0.2 primary; 50 secondary phase (text encoder trainable, generator frozen)
other.progressive_growing: Yes in full (all layers trainable), No in lightweight

inference.decoding: single forward pass; truncation psi in [0,1] interpolating w towards per-prompt mean [f~, c_text]
inference.samples: Fig 5: psi swept 1.0 to 0.0; eval FID30k (Tables 2-3), FID5k (Figs 5-6); number of runs/seeds not stated
inference.prompting: text prompts embedded by CLIP; styles by appending e.g. 'astronaut, {X}'

parameters.truncation_psi: 1.0 ... 0.0 range; no single final value stated

other.speed: 0.06 s at 64x64, 0.10 s at 256x256 on A100 (Tables 2-3); ~10 FPS (Fig 1)

metrics.name: Zero-shot FID30k / FID5k
metrics.definition: Frechet inception distance (Heusel 2017) on MS COCO, zero-shot

metrics.name: CLIP score
metrics.definition: CLIPScore (Hessel 2021) with ViT-g-14 trained on LAION-2B (different CLIP from the conditioning one)

metrics.name: Speed
metrics.definition: seconds to generate one image on A100 (TPUv4 for Imagen and Parti)

eval.protocol: Zero-shot MS COCO; other models' numbers from papers or correspondence with authors; ablations in lightweight config; no seeds or significance tests.

availability.data: public datasets (CC12M, CC, YFCC100m filtered, RedCaps, LAION-aesthetic-6+)

limits: Weak at binding attributes to objects and producing coherent text in images (Fig 9); authors suggest a larger language model would likely fix this at slower runtime.
Super-resolution stage underperforms; 256x256 FID 13.90 trails SD (8.59), Imagen (7.27), eDiff-I (6.95).
Strong CLIP guidance causes image artifacts; truncation moves toward a single mode unlike multi-modal diffusion guidance.
Compared FID numbers for other models are from papers or private correspondence, not rerun; no seeds, error bars or human evaluation.
Weights not released in paper; implementation promised only. Dated by later diffusion distillation and one-step models (not in paper).
